name: incline one arm push-up
description: A one-arm push-up with the hand on a bench or box. Raising the hand makes the movement easier while you learn to resist rotation.
instructions: Place one hand on a bench or sturdy box and your feet wider than your hips.
Put your other hand behind your back.
Keep your body in a straight line and your hips square to the floor.
Lower your chest toward the bench with control.
Press back up without twisting, then switch arms after your reps.
